resources.string: Approximate reminder. Resume opens Focus. Later parks the task.
Ongoing notice of the task to return to. It stays until you leave it. Elapsed time stays in the app.
Ongoing list of open Today tasks when nothing is in focus. Silent, with a small status icon. It stays until Today is empty.
Approximate reminders. Android may delay them. Backpin does not use exact alarms.
One silent notice when a countdown reaches its day and comes into focus. Never during quiet hours.
It\'s in focus now. Open Focus to choose where it goes.
